thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: control-plane 5xx spike detected (auth/org-lookup paths). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2487654321 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2487. Pager routed to oncall-sre. Initial symptom: short lived ramp of 502/504 from gateway -> auth/org-lookup.

mira: seeing a lot of `GET /v1/orgs/*/lookup` 502s from gateway in the last 90s. p50 ok, p95/p99 huge. :eyes:

dan: saw a config push ~15m ago for org-index caching TTL change. rolling back that config now if we confirm.

raj: digging into auth logs — org-lookup is timing out to backing DB (read replicas 3/4 showing high read latency). stack traces showing `Timeout waiting for connection` from connection pool.

oncall-sre: I'm on pager. taking ownership of live mitigation. Can someone run quick canary failover to secondary auth region? If not, enable circuit breaker and increase client-side TTL.

mira: canary failover isn't automated for this path. we can scale org-lookup workers + bump pool size quick. running commands now:
```bash
# scale deployment
kubectl scale deployment org-lookup --replicas=8 -n redwood-control
# bump db pool env var
kubectl set env deployment/org-lookup DB_POOL_MAX=60 -n redwood-control
```

dan: rolling back the TTL change in config service now (patch):
```json
{"org_index":{"cache_ttl_seconds":3600}}
```
applied to config-service for prod.

raj: applied a temporary circuit-breaker in gateway for auth calls (5xx threshold -> open) to reduce cascading. added a short 30s shouldary window.

billing-eng: heads up — we have a small subset of tenants seeing elevated request failures. Billed usage may underreport; we'll track request counts for reconciliation.

product-ops: preparing a short status page update. need rough customer impact: are auth failures causing sign-in or API calls to fail?

mira: API calls that require org lookup are failing. sign-in completes but some downstream calls return 502. estimate impacted sessions ~0.7% of active requests in the last 5m.

oncall-sre: mitigation checklist so far:
- rolled back config TTL change (dan)
- scaled org-lookup pods to 8 (mira)
- increased DB pool size (mira)
- added gateway circuit-breaker on auth path (raj)
- temporary KV prefix cache warmed for top callers (manual)
- status page inbound (product-ops)

sec-team: any suspicious spikes in auth traffic or malformed requests? could be a traffic amplification bug.

raj: no abnormal auth token shapes. traffic volume modestly higher (+12%), but DB read latency is root cause. likely contention from TTL change leading to cache misses and DB storm.

oncall-sre: short term: keep CB open for 5m, monitor 5xx rate and p99 latencies. If 5xx remains >1% for 10m, escalate to infra for DB replica failover.

dan: I've pushed a fallback in gateway to return cached metadata for heavily requested org IDs if DB fails — reduces pressure. snippet:
```yaml
- route: /v1/orgs/{id}/lookup
  on_error: return_cached || 503
```

mira: after scale + rollback, p95 reduced ~40%, 5xx rate is trending down from 3.2% -> 0.9% in last 6m.

incident-bot: INC-2487 update: severity = SEV2. Pager: oncall-sre -> holding. Next update in 10m or on state change.

product-ops: posting to status.redwood.com now: "We are investigating elevated errors on org lookup, mitigations underway." :white_check_mark:

billing-eng: collecting list of tenant IDs for potential compensations. sending DM to ops for extraction.

oncall-sre: handing off to raj for watch. I need to get coffee and will be offline in ~8m, but will remain reachable via phone if things regress.

raj: taking watch. will keep CB open and monitor read latencies + queue depth. setting up dashboards and a short eval run for replay traffic.

mira: also enabling a short-lived traffic shed for non-interactive API clients (low priority keys) to reduce DB load: `rate-limit: 100r/m per key` until healthy.

sec-team: marking this as not security related, but will keep an eye.

incident-bot: Note: create follow-up ticket INC-2487-POSTMORTEM and assign postmortem lead. Suggested: mira.

mira: happy to lead postmortem. will collect timeline + root cause (config -> cache miss -> DB read storm) and propose compensating controls: safer config rollouts, canary for cache TTL, autoscaling DB read replicas, and autoscale read pool burst.

product-ops: ETA for public incident report? 24h unless scope changes.

raj: last check at +10m into mitigation: 5xx at 0.6%, p99 latency dropping. keeping watch for 20 more minutes then closing incident if stable.

incident-bot: INC-2487 status: monitoring -> recovery. Closing actions: handoff complete, postmortem ticket created.

mira: adding final note: double-checked no billing data corruption. only request failures. billing-eng will reconcile counts.

billing-eng: thanks — will follow up on reconciliation and compensation list.

oncall-sre: thanks team — good response. follow-up in postmortem for safer rollout practices. :thumbsup:
